disclosure.note: the scale that would put the measured MAXIMUM pool magnitude exactly at the +-1 clip; recorded so the headroom this calibration leaves is auditable, not applied

distribution.quantity: abs(pre-gain, pre-scale pool mean) = abs(fsum(weight * activity) / summed_abs_weight), pooled over both wing-motor pools and every measured tick

encoder.note: binds this calibration to the exact engineered-encoder document and population membership it was measured under; the wing calibration carries no encoder section and the two are mutually refused at load time

measured_under.note: the pre-calibration (readout_scale 1.0) controller identity the distribution below was measured with; the calibrated controller necessarily carries a different configuration and decoder identity

collision_derivation.note: the closest two-byte approximation of the declared Bernoulli p = 0.1; the exact executed probability is 6554/65536

stream.observation_derivation: rays (bytes 0:12) and light (byte 12, uniform 0..15) from sha256('full-readout-calibration-eem-v1:<tick>') bytes; horizontal/vertical collisions from bytes 13:15 / 15:17 as declared Bernoulli(6554/65536); deterministic, no PRNG
